title: At least 10 new Dem members will carry Al Green's mantle and try to impeach President Trump

title: Jeffries promises ‘remedial assistance’ to anyone impacted by Trump immigration enforcement
summary: Hakeem Jeffries pledged to drive down cost of living on housing, healthcare, and groceries, but he also vowed remedial assistance for DACA recipients.

title: Dems projected to score historic upset in deep-red Mississippi, topple Trump ally Hyde-Smith
